title: Participatory Budgeting & Citizen Voting
subtitle: Decide how municipal tax funds are invested in expat integration, green spaces, and community culture

wallet.title: Your Resident Voting Tokens
wallet.budget_rule: Each registered resident receives 5 voting tokens to allocate toward community proposals.

hel_library_hub.title: Multilingual Reading & Co-working Hub at Central Library
hel_library_hub.description: Establish a designated international community zone at Oodi Library with literature in 15+ languages, meeting spaces, and weekly language exchanges.

hel_language_cafes.title: Free Pop-up Finnish Language Cafes in Local Parks
hel_language_cafes.description: Weekly summer open-air conversational language cafes led by native teachers across Kallio, Pasila, and Töölönlahti.

tam_winter_sauna.title: Winter Community Sauna & Ice Swimming Pier Enhancement
tam_winter_sauna.description: Expand community-run public sauna facilities and heated changing rooms on Lake Näsijärvi to welcome international residents into sauna culture.

tam_esports_academy.title: Youth Esports & Coding Academy After-School Club
tam_esports_academy.description: Multilingual gaming and programming workshops for immigrant children and Finnish youth in Hervanta to build friendships through technology.

esp_nature_trails.title: Multilingual Nature Trail Wayfinding & Audio Guides
esp_nature_trails.description: Install educational nature signs and QR-audio guides in Finnish, Swedish, English, and Ukrainian along Nuuksio and coastal paths.

oul_bike_stations.title: All-Weather Bicycle Repair & Pump Stations Across City
oul_bike_stations.description: Set up 10 free, covered self-service bike repair stations with pumps and tools along major cycling expressways.

tur_river_festival.title: Riverfront International Food & Culture Summer Festival
tur_river_festival.description: A 3-day multicultural open-air weekend on Aurajoki riverbanks featuring traditional foods, music performances, and integration workshops.

van_community_garden.title: Community Urban Garden & Greenhouse for Immigrant Families
van_community_garden.description: Create 60 allotment garden plots and a shared greenhouse in Tikkurila where locals and newcomers can grow vegetables together.
